# Swappr

> Swappr is a free Android app for simple multi-coin crypto swaps: pick the pair, check the estimated amount and limits, add your address and confirm. No exchange terminal needed.

Swappr is made by GSPTeck, giosaia's indie studio, and is a CoinX project. It is listed on Google Play as "Swappr: Crypto Coin Swap" (package com.gspteck.swappr). Swaps are processed by FixedFloat. The app never asks for a seed phrase and does not store a balance for you. While an order runs, coins sit at a FixedFloat deposit address. Swappr is currently available only for Android on Google Play.

## Cost

The app is free to install, shows ads, and has no in-app purchases. A swap is not free: it carries the swap provider's fee plus the blockchain network fee. As published on this site (fees last checked 2026-11-13), FixedFloat charges 1% plus the network fee on a fixed rate and 0.5% plus the network fee on a float rate, and the app shows the amount you will receive before you confirm. Sending the deposit from your own wallet also costs that chain's network fee.
